name: Paragon Banking Group PLC
summary: Paragon Banking Group PLC provides financial products and services in the United Kingdom. It operates in two segments, Mortgage Lending and Commercial Lending. The Mortgage Lending segment offers buy-to-let mortgages, and owner-occupied first and second charge lending. The Commercial Lending segment comprises equipment leasing, development finance, structured lending, and other offerings for SME customers, as well as motor finance business. This segment also provides hire purchase, business loans, and operating and finance leasing.
